verdict.rationale: An email service could plausibly ship AI-generated insights or suggestions, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any AI-generated insight, summary or suggestion feature in Fastmail. Community users note it lacks Gmail-style auto-categorization and implicit summary cards, and the only workarounds mentioned are third-party tools such as Sanebox, which earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
